    EyeModel_
    ImageJ plugin to calculate eye frequency response using either Richard and Siewerdsen 2008, http://dx.doi.org/10.1118/1.2988161: E(f) = f^n.exp(-c.f^2) where n = 1.3 c = 3.093 for a 50 cm viewing distance for E(f) to peak at 4 cycles/degree or Solomon et al 2015, http://dx.doi.org/10.1118/1.4923172: E(p) = |n.p^(a1).exp(-a2.p^a3)|^2 where a1 = 1.5 a2 = 0.98 a3 = 0.68 n is a normalisation constant to make max E(p) = 1.0 p (rho, really) is angular spatial frequency expressed in cycles per degree p can be calculated from radial spatial frequency using: p = (f.FOV.R.pi) / (D.180) where f is radial spatial frequency FOV is the reconstructed field of view of the image R is the viewing distance D is the display size (assumed to be 30.5 cm in the Solomon paper) Note to self: is D the physical size of the full image as displayed on the screen? If so, can calculate this if know the pixel pitch in mm, the pixel dimensions of the image and the zoom factor...
